policies.title: Moldovan ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa at port of entry
policies.summary: Grenada's current Embassy schedule names Moldova in its Port of Entry category, which the schedule defines as a visa granted on arrival in Grenada.
conditions: Ordinary Moldovan passport, visitor entry at a Grenadian port of entry under the schedule's named Moldova row.
The schedule states that visitor periods, purposes other than visiting, passport validity, documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: Grenada's official Embassy schedule expressly places Moldova in the Port of Entry category and defines that category as a visa granted on arrival, rather than visa-free entry.
